# Flavors Kitchen + Bar

> Flavors Kitchen + Bar is a forthcoming world-cuisine restaurant in Bedford, NY, with a wood-fired pizza program, shareable world plates and a craft cocktail bar. Opening soon.

## Menu
The menu is still being written and has not been published. Planned: wood-fired, long-fermented pizza; shareable plates from cuisines around the world; small plates; craft cocktails.

## Location & Contact
- Address: 720 N Bedford Rd, Bedford, NY 10506, US
- Phone: Coming soon
- Contact: [Online contact form](visit.html#contact-form)

- To be announced
